headline: Is Stryker (SYK) Undervalued As Earnings Trigger A Fresh Valuation Question?
summary: Stryker (SYK) is back in focus after its second quarter 2026 earnings, reporting sales of US$6.59b and net income of US$1.28b, alongside a sharp market reaction to the release. See our latest analysis for Stryker. The 1 day share price return of Stryker fell 6.42% on the earnings release, which pulled the year to date share price return down 6.46%, while the 5 year total shareholder return of 30.66% still reflects longer term gains.
